query: Someone forged a document to claim property. What offence may apply?

gold_references.label: Section 336
gold_references.role: forgery - making false document to support a claim or title

acceptable_references.label: Section 338
acceptable_references.reason: forgery of valuable security, will, or property authority - enhanced punishment

acceptable_references.label: Section 335
acceptable_references.reason: defines what constitutes making a false document

required_points: Section 336 defines forgery as making a false document with intent to cause damage or injury, to support any claim or title, or to cause any person to part with property.
Making a forged document to claim property clearly falls within this definition.
If the forged document purports to be a will or valuable security, the enhanced punishment provisions of Section 338 apply.
optional_points: Using the forged document as genuine would additionally attract Section 340.
forbidden_points: Forging a document to claim property is only cheating, not forgery.
Forgery requires use of a printing press.

notes: Scenario query. Section 336 for forgery, Section 338 if document is will or security.
